title: Density of an integer multiplicity weight equals its multiplicity Hⁿ-a.e. on the carrier inside an open set (Simon Ch. 3, Remarks 1.5(3) and 1.8, Theorem 1.9)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in V (IMRep V n: M ⊆ V Borel and countably n-rectifiable, θ : ℝ^P → ℕ Borel with θ ≥ 1 on M, ξ orienting the approximate tangent space of M at Hⁿ-a.e. point of M, Hⁿ = μHE[n]), with weight μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (R.measure). Let W ⊆ ℝ^P be open and assume μ_R(K ∩ W) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P with x ∈ M ∩ W, μ_R(B_ρ(x) ∩ W)/(ω_nρⁿ) → θ(x) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n, and the denominator is written unitBallVolume n · ofReal(ρⁿ) (division in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen W → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure (K ∩ W) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ R.carrier ∩ W → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ ∩ W) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞))
